data.narrative:
Orbital Composites is a seed-stage company in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Cole Nielsen and Amolak Badesha, having raised $6.6M to date. The broader sector includes 9 comparable companies (1 public, 8 private), with notable private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Given the company's early stage and limited peer set, a single valuation method was applicable. Stage-Progression analysis, using the $6.6M total raised as a proxy for implied post-seed value, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A step-ups in this sector, yielding $16.5M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—while 11 robotics companies exist in the dataset, only 1 operates at the same stage and 1 at an adjacent stage, falling short of the minimum 3-datapoint threshold for reliable cross-sectional analysis.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M to $19M, with a median point of $16M. This reflects conservative and optimistic treatments of stage progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier to Orbital Composites' specific technology and market position, and the lack of direct peer data at seed stage for calibration. Further validation would require either tighter robotics manufacturing comparables or additional forward-looking metrics on revenue trajectory and IP defensibility.
